messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from last night's kv-cache incident — we sketched fixes but need concrete owners for test/eval work and measurable acceptance criteria. Posting proposals here.

michael: I can take the regression harness for kv-cache (unit + integration). ETA ~2w. Will add CI job and a readme for the failure modes.

sophie: I'll own the prompt-set additions for chat fallback and rare token-corruption cases. Planning ~30 prompts + expected outputs + label taxonomy. ETA 10d.

rachel: Ops will add a recurring chaos drill and tweak sampling for failed completions. I'll calendar monthly drills for the next 3 months and raise sampling x5 for 24h after any serving deploy. ETA 3d.

tony: Suggest adding a load test scenario to Redwood Optimize to model bursty short requests (high QPS, low tokens). I'll pair with @michael on metrics and thresholds. ETA 2w.

ana: Can we make concrete acceptance criteria here? e.g. regression detects 10% injected kv-miss, load p95 < 250ms under baseline, chaos recovers routing <60s.

michael: Agree. I'll implement a simulated kv-miss injector in the regression harness and CI gate: fail if token error rate >0.2% or fallback success <99%. Will open PR with tests and reference.

sophie: For prompts: repo path `evals/incident/kv-cache/fallback_prompts.md` with expected outputs and a small eval runner that runs nightly on canary traffic. Also include adversarial variants to catch token-order/encoding issues.

rachel: Chaos drill plan: kill a single serving shard during steady traffic for 15m, observe fallback, routing, and cost impact. Run first Tue monthly, friction window 09:00-12:00 PT. I'll add invites + on-call handoff notes.

tony: Load test details: simulate 5k QPS of 1-3 token responses for 10m, measure p50/p95/p99, and error waterfall. Add to Optimize pipeline as a scheduled job and as a pre-rollout smoke test.

ana: I'll update the postmortem tracker with owners/timelines and acceptance criteria. Please comment if ETA or scope needs adjustment.

incident-bot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/kv-cache-2026-03-21

deploy-bot: Reminder: when CI and regression are green you can request a staged deploy via `/deploy staged`.

michael: Recap of concrete TODOs I'm creating now: `ci/jobs/regression-kv-cache` (unit+integration), kv-miss injector test, CI gate thresholds, PR references to postmortem.

sophie: I'll add the prompt file + small eval harness and wire it to nightly canary evals. Will include expected failure labels.

rachel: I'll push calendar invites and a short playbook for the chaos drill (~1 pager) and ops runbook changes for sampling.

tony: I'll draft the load test config and a dashboard that surfaces the regression metrics we agreed on.

ana: Final owner list for the postmortem doc: michael (regression harness + CI gate, ETA 2w), sophie (prompt set + eval, ETA 10d), rachel (alert sampling + chaos schedule, ETA 3d), tony (load test + chaos playbook pairing, ETA 2w). I'll ping next Tue for status. :thumbsup:

ana: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
